purpose: Form NCLT-1 is used for filing various applications to the Tribunal under the Companies Act, 2013, such as applications under section 131 for revision of financial statements or Board's report, section 241, section 7(7), and certain debenture or deposit related matters.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the application in Form NCLT-1 containing the required particulars and details.
Attach the required documents as mentioned in Annexure-B.
Annex any specific supporting documents, lists, affidavits, or letters of consent required by the specific section rules.
Serve a copy of the application on the company, other respondents, and directed persons where applicable.
File the application with the Tribunal.
checklist: List of depositors or debenture holders with full details if applicable
Affidavit from the company stating the list of depositors or debenture holders is correct if the company is the applicant
Letter of consent signed by other entitled members where applicable
Schedule setting out names and addresses of all members on whose behalf the application is presented
Statement on whether applicants have paid all calls and sums due on shares
Copy of Board resolution and particulars required for section 131 applications
Details of incorporation, subscribers, promoters, first directors, and false or suppressed information for section 7(7) applications
attachments: List of depositors or debenture holders
Affidavit stating the list of depositors or debenture holders is correct
Letter of consent signed by the rest of the members
watch: Ensure all specific particulars, lists, and Annexure-B documents required for the particular type of application are properly included.
